faqs.question: What is Warflex™?
faqs.answer: Warflex™ is an advanced pre-workout with Boron Citrate for the advanced athlete from Promolecules. It contains Beta-Alanine, Creatine Monohydrate, Creatine HCl, L-Citrulline, Taurine, Alpha GPC, Agmatine Sulfate, Multiple Sources of Caffeine, Alpha Yohimbine, and Huperzine-A to help support workout energy, focus, strength, endurance, and performance.

faqs.question: Who should use Warflex™?
faqs.answer: Warflex™ is for healthy adults 18+ who have taken stimulant pre-workout supplements before and is not recommended for beginners or those sensitive to caffeine due to its high stimulant content.

faqs.question: How do I take Warflex™?
faqs.answer: Start with ½ scoop blended in 4–6 oz (120–180 ml) of water 30 minutes before exercise to assess tolerance. If well tolerated, take 1 full scoop mixed in 8–10 oz (240–300 ml) of water 30 minutes before your workout. Do not exceed 1 serving per day.

faqs.question: What ingredients are included in Warflex™?
faqs.answer: Each serving includes Beta-Alanine (2000 mg), Creatine Monohydrate (1000 mg), L-Citrulline (1000 mg), Creatine HCl (500 mg), Taurine (500 mg), Alpha GPC (50%), Eria Jarensis Extract, Agmatine Sulfate, Beet Root Extract, Juniper Berry Extract, Caffeine Anhydrous, Dicaffeine Malate, Caffeine Citrate, Caffeine HCl, Citrus Aurantium Extract, L-Theanine, Alpha Yohimbine, Boron Citrate, and Huperzine-A.

faqs.question: Does Warflex™ contain caffeine?
faqs.answer: Yes. Warflex™ contains multiple caffeine sources including Caffeine Anhydrous, Dicaffeine Malate, Caffeine Citrate, and Caffeine HCl to help support alertness, workout readiness, and energy.

faqs.question: Does Warflex™ contain creatine?
faqs.answer: Yes. Warflex™ contains Creatine Monohydrate and Creatine HCl (CreaCCL®) to support high-intensity exercise performance with regular resistance exercise.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of Boron Citrate in Warflex™?
faqs.answer: Boron Citrate is a trace mineral commonly included in sports nutrition formulas. It plays a role in normal mineral metabolism and is frequently used in advanced performance supplements.

faqs.question: Is Warflex™ suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: No. Warflex™ is intended for advanced users, and the label clearly states "Not for Beginners." New users should consider a lower-stimulant pre-workout and always assess their tolerance.

faqs.question: Can I take Warflex™ every day?
faqs.answer: Take Warflex™ only as directed on the product label and do not exceed 1 serving per day. If you have questions about regular use, consult a qualified healthcare professional.

faqs.question: Can I combine Warflex™ with other supplements?
faqs.answer: Warflex™ may be used with other compatible sports nutrition products. However, due to its high caffeine and stimulant content, do not combine it with other stimulant supplements or energy drinks.

faqs.question: Is Warflex™ manufactured in a quality-certified facility?
faqs.answer: Yes. According to the product label, Warflex™ is manufactured and developed exclusively for Promolecules in a cGMP-certified facility, supporting consistent manufacturing standards.

faqs.question: Where can I buy Warflex™?
faqs.answer: You can purchase Warflex™ directly from the official Promolecules website or through authorized retail partners to help ensure product authenticity.
